summary: A labeled group of related form fields, with the group's own heading.
description: Fieldset wrapper used to lay out form inputs consistently, with an optional legend (label), description, icon, badge, and support link.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The label for the fieldset's legend.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The description text for the fieldset.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Name of the SUMO support page to link to (attribute: support-page). When unset, a named "support-link" slot is rendered instead so callers can supply their own link.

attributes.name: headingLevel
attributes.description: Renders the legend as h1-h6 instead of plain legend text. Default is -1 (no heading).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the fieldset and, via a MutationObserver-style pass over children, propagates a disabled/parentDisabled state to nested form controls that support it.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: Src for an optional icon shown next to the legend.

attributes.name: badge
attributes.description: Includes a moz-badge of this type next to the legend. Options: beta, new.

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: Accessible label, mapped from the aria-label attribute.

attributes.name: ariaOrientation
attributes.description: Mapped aria-orientation attribute for the fieldset.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Mapped role attribute for the inner fieldset element, applied only when set.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: The form inputs laid out inside the fieldset.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Rendered only when supportPage is not set; lets callers supply a custom support link element in place of the built-in moz-support-link.

usage:
<moz-fieldset label="Related settings" description="Optional supporting text">
  <moz-checkbox label="Option one"></moz-checkbox>
</moz-fieldset>

cssParts.name: inputs
cssParts.description: The wrapper around the fieldset's slotted inputs.
